[{"insert":"1 1/4 Cyclist Back Squat

The 1 1/4 cyclist back squat adds a quarter rep at the bottom of each full rep. Lower all the way down, rise a quarter of the way up, return to the bottom, then stand fully. The heel elevation keeps the demand almost entirely on the quads. The extra quarter rep at the bottom doubles the time under tension in the hardest position of the squat. Reps drop across the odd weeks so the weight goes up each time it returns.
"}]
